name: slot-picker

frames.best_why: Slot and button are green with a tick, showing the confirmed booking after the pick.

tagline: A compact booking panel with a day rail; click a free gap to place a meeting.
summary: A meeting scheduler with a five-day strip, duration choices and an hourly day rail. Click a free gap to drop a slot, drag it around busy blocks, then confirm.
appearance: A light rounded card shows an avatar, a meeting title and host, a segmented duration switch and five date buttons with free-hour notes. Below, a vertical day rail marks hours and hatched busy blocks, with a blue selected slot and a Confirm button underneath.
behaviour: Clicking a free gap drops a blue slot on the rail; hovering elsewhere previews it, dragging hops it around busy blocks, and arrow keys step it. Confirm turns it green and marks the button Booked.
demo_content: Product walkthrough with Lena Ortiz, Lisbon; days Mon 2 to Fri 6 Nov; Eastern Time, New York.
search_phrases: pick a time slot on a timeline
drag a meeting over busy blocks
schedule a call with free gaps
use_when: A booking flow needs a compact day view where people can see free gaps and place a meeting.
avoid_when: It shows only the five supplied days with a fixed rail scale, so it needs your own data and paging.
customise: Host details, a days array of open and busy spans, duration options, timezone and a book callback are props; colours and rail scale are constants.
weight_why: A small panel with layout animations; it idles between picks.

a11y.note: Every control is labelled and arrow keys move the slot; the rail also offers a keyboard fallback to place the first gap.

props.name: host
props.type: { name: string; title?: string; city?: string; offset?: number }
props.default: { name: "Lena Ortiz", title: "Product walkthrough", city: "Lisbon", offset: 300 }

props.name: onBook
props.type: (slot: { date: string; start: number; minutes: number }) => void

issues: Busy blocks are faint grey hatching on a light rail, so occupied hours are easy to miss.
polish_why: A well-structured booking flow with a clear slot and tidy spacing; busy hatching is faint.
title: Slot Picker
